summary: Bella Coola Airport serves the remote coastal community of Bella Coola in British Columbia's Chilcotin region, providing essential air access to an area otherwise reachable only via the long and winding Highway 20. The airport acts as a primary gateway for visitors heading to Tweedsmuir Provincial Park, the Great Bear Rainforest, and one of Canada's most pristine wilderness corridors.
